leadText:
If you were looking for the Pokémon GO Season, see World of Wonders.

World of Wonder is the English ending theme for Pokémon: Eevee & Friends.
plainText:
If you were looking for the Pokémon GO Season, see World of Wonders.

World of Wonder is the English ending theme for Pokémon: Eevee & Friends.

==Lyrics==
 It's much better
When we're together
That's the way it's meant to be
It's much better
When we're together
It feels so good when it's you and me

It's much better
When we're together
Having fun, feeling free
Wish this could go
On forever
It feels so good when it's you and me
Come on!

In this world of wonder
Sparkling sunshine colors so bright
The air is filled with magic
And there's laughter day and night

Good times and excitement
Reunited once again
Singing all our favorite songs
Celebrating, we're the best of friends!

It's much better
When we're together
That's the way it's meant to be
It's much better
When we're together
It feels so good when it's you and me

Oooh
What a great sight to see 
(What a great sight to see)
Oooh
We fit so magically
(We fit so magically)
Oooh
We're together once again
(We're together once again)
Singing all our favorite songs
Celebrating, we're the best of friends!

It's much better
When we're together (together!)
That's the way it's meant to be
It's much better
When we're together
It feels so good when it's you and me

It's much better
When we're together (when we're together!)
Having fun, feeling free (feeling free!)
Wish this could go
On forever
It feels so good when it's you and me
Come on! 

==Credits==
Music and lyrics by John Loeffler and David Wolfert
Produced by John Loeffler and David Wolfert
Vocals by Kathryn Raio
Track by David Wolfert
